description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/column_nonuniform_1d/rules/varcoeff_face_laplacian_lev_value_bc driven by problems/heat_column_varcoeff_value_bc.esm (variable interface coefficient K = 1 + z, manufactured forcing, supplied boundary values u_sfc = exp(-t) and u_top = 2 exp(-t) with nonzero, unequal face fluxes). The problem file is loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4). Nothing is discretely exact, so the recorded L2 errors at t=0.1 are the full spatial error of the interface-coefficient flux-difference stencil with the half-cell one-sided boundary-value closure on a stretched mesh, expected to fall as O(dz^2) (the closure is first order locally in the two boundary layers; the global error is second order).

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
